svg.aria-label: Joint-MCMC and neural recovery of the spread multiplier
svg.title: Joint-MCMC and neural recovery of the spread multiplier
svg.desc: Three recovery panels retain every available ready case with its 90% posterior interval. The fourth compares interval widths with the fixed Uniform prior width.
